races.name: Mercedes-Benz Of Chichester Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Sorgean
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with good form who faces significant traffic danger in a congested race

runners_data.name: Hidden Fortune
runners_data.note: Front runner with stamina pedigree returning after 38 days, sister to 3m winner suggests trip suits
runners_data.comment: 3m point winner for whom the step up in trip could be a firm plus on hurdle debut
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner (3m, good to yielding) who was runner-up on both bumpers starts (good to soft/good); she's a sister to a 3m hurdle winner and the step up in trip could be a firm positive on her first hurdle start.

runners_data.name: Secret Des Lune
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader who has been off 59 days and faces pace pressure from Hidden Fortune

runners_data.name: Queens Up
runners_data.note: Hold-up type but lightly raced and inconsistent, 20 days since last run is positive

runners_data.name: Rock Sensation
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 144 days layoff, good record on similar going

runners_data.name: Shutfrontdoor
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with consistent form but carried by inexperienced 3lb claimer

runners_data.name: Whodunit
runners_data.note: Prominent type who fades in finish, dangerous pattern for traffic-heavy race

runners_data.name: Diamond White
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with decent form but needs to avoid the squeeze

runners_data.name: Saffron Belle
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who fades late, benefits from strong pace but finishing kick questionable

runners_data.name: Flash Bardot
runners_data.note: Patient hold-up type with proven form, benefits from tactical race shape

races.paceDynamic: Secret Des Lune and Hidden Fortune are confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, creating an honest gallop from the off. With Sorgean, Shutfrontdoor, Whodunit, and Diamond White all wanting prominent positions, there's significant congestion behind the leaders through the middle stages. This pace setup creates tactical pressure 2-3 out when the prominent brigade get squeezed for racing room. The contested early pace and prominent traffic jam strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble and finish with one run.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine and the prominent pack gets squeezed approaching 2 out
scenarios.body: The pace collapses allow late runners to sweep past tired leaders, with hold-up specialists having clear runs while prominent runners are caught in traffic. Rock Sensation and Flash Bardot benefit from patient rides and finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent pack gets first run before the squeeze develops
scenarios.body: Shutfrontdoor or Sorgean uses experience to slip the field before traffic becomes an issue, holding off late challengers with tactical advantage. The winner gets clear racing room while others are still organizing behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Wires The Field
scenarios.trigger: If Secret Des Lune or Hidden Fortune gets an uncontested lead and steady fractions
scenarios.body: The front runner dictates comfortable fractions without pressure, saving energy for the finish while prominent runners waste energy fighting for position. Hidden Fortune's stamina pedigree suits this scenario perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and prominent pack gets caught napping
scenarios.body: The entire pace setup falls apart with leaders stopping and prominent runners caught flat-footed, allowing a complete outsider to steal through. Only the most patient hold-up horse benefits from the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Secret Des Lune and Hidden Fortune will clash early - if either gets loose it changes the entire complexion
Shutfrontdoor carries inexperienced Freddie Mitchell who may get caught in the prominent squeeze
Rock Sensation returns after 144 days which could blunt finishing kick despite favorable race shape
Whodunit and Saffron Belle both fade late - any signs of early urgency from their jockeys spells trouble
Queens Up is the most lightly raced runner - market support would indicate hidden ability

races.name: KSR Lighting Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Belgarum
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 168-day layoff but trainer form poor at 0/5 in last 14 days raising fitness concerns.

runners_data.name: Sun Joy
runners_data.note: Proven prominent performer with solid recent form including a win, though 185 days off the track creates stamina questions.

runners_data.name: Motazzen
runners_data.note: The lone leader whose recent form is patchy but gets uncontested lead to suit front-running style perfectly.

runners_data.name: Oakley
runners_data.note: Prominent style with amateur jockey claim and very recent run giving fitness edge, though topweight burden significant.

runners_data.name: Bel Ombre
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with decent recent form but needs strong pace to unleash finishing kick over this trip.

runners_data.name: Taritino
runners_data.note: Back-marker with good recent form but lowest weight won't help if pace doesn't develop sufficiently.

runners_data.name: Hiconic
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 256-day absence with trainer hitting form but extended layoff major concern.

runners_data.name: Khalk'eau Spigao
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner completely outclassed on ratings and inexperienced over hurdles with poor recent form.

races.paceDynamic: Motazzen will take them along from the front as the sole confirmed leader, likely setting a steady but manageable gallop over this extended trip. The prominent brigade of Belgarum, Sun Joy, Oakley and Hiconic should track within striking distance, while the hold-up trio of Bel Ombre, Taritino and Khalk'eau Spigao will need the pace to develop strongly enough to set up their finishing kicks. With no obvious pace pressure on Motazzen and several strong finishers needing something to aim at, this tactical setup strongly favours horses who can position prominently and have the stamina to grind out the finish over 2m3f.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Motazzen Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Motazzen dictates fractions without serious challenge through the mid-race.
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time of it and proves hard to peg back, while the prominent trackers benefit from the honest gallop more than the hold-up horses stuck behind a slowly-run affair. Those positioned handy have first strike on any weakening leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Grind
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely testing from halfway as the prominent horses start to press.
scenarios.body: The extended trip and sustained gallop finds out any stamina limitations while suiting the proven stayers positioned to strike. Hold-up horses still struggle to make up significant ground in a truly-run test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If Motazzen goes too slow early and the race becomes a sprint from the last mile.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the back-markers to get into contention and their superior finishing speed becomes decisive. Front-runners and prominent racers get swamped by the late charge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Motazzen Surprise Win
scenarios.trigger: If the leader gets such an easy time that stamina reserves remain intact for the finish.
scenarios.body: Despite his recent moderate form, Motazzen's class tells when allowed to dictate ideal fractions throughout. The field fails to mount a serious enough challenge to his soft lead.

watchPoints.text: Motazzen getting an uncontested lead could prove decisive if allowed to dictate soft fractions throughout
Sun Joy and Belgarum both returning from lengthy layoffs may need the run despite their class advantages
Amateur jockey on Oakley carrying topweight could struggle if the pace becomes truly searching
Bel Ombre and Taritino need to watch for early pace development to set up their finishing kicks
Hiconic's 256-day absence makes this likely a prep run despite trainer's recent good form

races.name: Fontwell Park Half Year Membership Novices' Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: All Authorized
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist faces tactical challenge with likely moderate pace but benefits from return to more suitable trip after recent longer distances.

runners_data.name: Ballyfinn
runners_data.note: Prominent runner perfectly placed to follow up recent Fontwell success despite 7lb penalty, with Chad Bament's 5lb claim valuable compensation.
runners_data.comment: Breakthrough win here (3m2f) last Wednesday; down in trip under 7lb penalty; key candidate
runners_data.spotlight: Made the breakthrough on his fifth start over fences when scoring here (3m2f, good) last Wednesday; back down in trip under 7lb penalty but not fully exposed and looks a key player.

runners_data.name: Lord Maher
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but 161-day absence is major concern despite previous course form, needs to prove wind operation has helped.

runners_data.name: Thickthorn Tom
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse gains tongue-tie addition and benefits from Skelton yard's strong 32% strike-rate over past 14 days.
runners_data.comment: Second chase start when third (3m) latest; tongue-tie added and unexposed for top yard
runners_data.spotlight: Much the best of two chase starts when third of 11 at Exeter (3m, good to soft) in March; drops back in trip with a tongue-tie joining his cheekpieces; unexposed and he's respected for top yard.

runners_data.name: Jaffa Cake
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner will control tempo but recent poor form suggests stamina or jumping issues may surface under pressure.

runners_data.name: Lunar Ocean
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer but pulled up last time after jumping error, needs to prove confidence intact despite useful weight allowance.
runners_data.comment: Mainly consistent over fences; excuses last time and not ruled out in first-time blinkers
runners_data.spotlight: Can make mistakes but mainly consistent over fences for this yard; pulled up at Warwick after an error last time but 2m and ground that was likely faster than good were probably not ideal; that brought his record to 0-18 but he's not ruled out in first-time blinkers back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Misteroddsocks
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent course form but trainer's limited strike-rate and 36-day break raise minor fitness questions.

races.paceDynamic: Jaffa Cake will control this race from the front with no genuine pace pressure, creating a tactical contest rather than a true gallop. Ballyfinn and Lord Maher will track prominently but both lack the natural speed to seriously challenge early fractions. With three hold-up horses (All Authorized, Thickthorn Tom, Lunar Ocean) relying on late kicks, the moderate early pace will leave them with plenty to do in the closing stages. This setup strongly favours prominent runners who can position close enough to capitalize when the sprint develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ballyfinn Follows Up
scenarios.trigger: If Ballyfinn settles well tracking Jaffa Cake and maintains his current form spike.
scenarios.body: The recent Fontwell winner gets an ideal position behind the leader and has proven he handles this course and distance combination perfectly. His current confidence and course experience gives him a clear tactical edge when the race quickens approaching the final fence.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is even more sedate than expected, allowing back markers time to organize.
scenarios.body: All Authorized or Thickthorn Tom benefit from patient rides and stronger finishing kicks when the race becomes a sprint from the second-last. The Skelton yard's excellent 14-day record gives Thickthorn Tom particular appeal in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Jaffa Cake Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Jaffa Cake's front-running proves more effective than recent form suggests.
scenarios.body: The leader kicks clear turning for home and holds on grimly, benefiting from the lack of early pressure and sustaining his gallop better than expected. His stamina reserves prove deeper than topspeed figures indicate at this longer trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the modest early gallop becomes a crawl and several horses hit the front simultaneously.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble with multiple horses in contention at the last fence, favoring whoever jumps cleanest and has the most tactical speed. Course specialists and horses with recent race fitness gain crucial advantages in the final 100 yards.

watchPoints.text: Jaffa Cake's jumping accuracy at the third-last fence where front-runners often come under pressure for the first time.
Lord Maher's early position and breathing - any sign of struggling suggests the wind operation hasn't solved previous issues.
Ballyfinn's settling behavior in the early stages as he carries a penalty and faces a quicker turnaround than ideal.
Thickthorn Tom's jump at the second-last fence where his Exeter third showed he can be deliberate when tiredness sets in.
All Authorized's position turning for home - needs to be within six lengths to have realistic winning chance given the likely pace scenario.

races.name: Southern Cranes And Access Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Renoir
runners_data.note: Prominent runner perfectly placed if pace stays modest, though 25 days off and inconsistent form are concerns

runners_data.name: Hurst Hill
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs luck in running but trainer Seamus Mullins in decent form and consistent recent efforts

runners_data.name: Jager Time
runners_data.note: Class act returning from 193-day break with strong hold-up style, but long absence is a question mark

runners_data.name: Lady Henrietta
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits race shape though recent heavy ground runs and 104-day layoff create uncertainty

runners_data.name: Tell The Tale
runners_data.note: Unexposed on good ground with prominent style, but 117-day absence and soft ground form raise questions
runners_data.comment: Safely held in both handicaps (2m3f/3m) but may yet do better; market check advised
runners_data.spotlight: Safely held in first two handicaps (2m3f/3m, good to soft) and absent since January but remains unexposed (particularly on good ground) and is worth a glance in the betting.

runners_data.name: Counteract
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up performer with 20 days since last run, needs everything to fall right from bottom weight

runners_data.name: Nelson Gate
runners_data.note: Four-year-old hold-up runner with decent recent form but Moore stable struggling badly this season

runners_data.name: Porridge
runners_data.note: Hold-up style trapped by race shape and recent poor form makes him hard to fancy

runners_data.name: For Old Times Sake
runners_data.note: Sole leader but fading tendency and new tongue-tie create doubt over extended trip
runners_data.comment: Struggled in last two handicaps and now 0-6 over hurdles but not written off just yet
runners_data.spotlight: 0-6 over hurdles, having struggled in his last two handicaps (2m4f/2mf, good; warm favourite on first occasion); goes up in trip fitted with new tongue-tie; has a lot to prove but can't be written off yet.

runners_data.name: Gone Country
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with fading concerns and 52-day break, unlikely to overcome tactical disadvantage

runners_data.name: Anothermanicmonday
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits left-handed track switch but needs significant improvement from recent poor runs
runners_data.comment: Beaten about 60l on recent handicap debut at Exeter (2m2f); up in trip here
runners_data.spotlight: Jumped left throughout and was beaten about 60l on recent handicap debut at Exeter (2m2f, good); this switch to a left-handed track is an obvious move but he needs to take a big step forward over the new trip.

races.paceDynamic: For Old Times Sake provides the sole confirmed pace angle, but his warning of fading in the finish suggests he may not sustain the gallop over this extended trip. With most rivals adopting hold-up tactics (Hurst Hill, Jager Time, Counteract, Nelson Gate, Porridge, Gone Country, Anothermanicmonday), the early pace could be modest before quickening from the back straight. Renoir and Lady Henrietta as prominent runners will likely track For Old Times Sake early, positioning themselves ideally if the leader weakens. This shape strongly favours prominent runners who can avoid getting caught behind a wall of hold-up horses in a slowly-run race that becomes a sprint.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays modest and For Old Times Sake fades as expected
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical with hold-up horses trapped behind traffic, allowing prominent runners to dictate from ideal positions. Renoir and Lady Henrietta can control their destiny from the front rank rather than relying on luck in running.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get clear runs and the pace lifts enough to suit their style
scenarios.body: One of the stronger hold-up performers gets the perfect split at the right moment to unleash their finishing kick. Jager Time's class and recent form, or Hurst Hill's consistency, could prove decisive in a truly-run contest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Suits
scenarios.trigger: If For Old Times Sake sets crawling fractions and stays longer than expected
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop plays into the leader's hands despite his finishing concerns over shorter trips. Tell The Tale's good ground form and unexposed nature could also benefit from these tactical circumstances.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a messy scramble with multiple fallers or significant interference
scenarios.body: The tactical nature creates opportunities for outsiders to benefit from others' misfortune or to find gaps that wouldn't normally appear. Nelson Gate's youth or Counteract's experience could capitalize on a chaotic finish.

watchPoints.text: For Old Times Sake's jumping early - if he makes mistakes the pace could collapse completely and change the entire complexion
Traffic problems in the home straight - with seven hold-up horses, several will get blocked and need clear splits late
Renoir's fitness after 25-day break - if he's not sharp enough he won't capitalize on his tactical advantage
Lady Henrietta's jumping on return to hurdles after 104 days - any rustiness could cost her prime position
Jager Time's market move - significant support would suggest connections expect him sharp despite the long layoff

races.name: V2 Radio Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)

runners_data.name: Gone In Sixty
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returns from 172-day break but has strong course record and benefits from patient tactics in slowly-run races

runners_data.name: Ballywood
runners_data.note: Sole pace-setter will dictate terms from the front, veteran campaigner knows how to conserve energy when unchallenged

runners_data.name: Grain Trade
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with solid recent form, headgear change suggests connections expect improvement from patient ride

runners_data.name: Holy Legend
runners_data.note: Hold-up type carrying bottom weight but modest recent form and headgear suggests struggling for confidence

runners_data.name: Daany
runners_data.note: Prominent runner fresh from 9-day break, solid recent second suggests maintains current form level

runners_data.name: Saint Polo
runners_data.note: Hold-up type drops back sharply in trip from longer distances, class performer who could benefit from patient tactics
runners_data.comment: Unexposed in h'cap hurdles and back down in trip for this chase debut; cheekpieces added
runners_data.spotlight: Went close on handicap debut over hurdles at Sedgefield (2m4f) in March before solid third at Taunton (3m, also good) one month later; drops sharply back in trip with cheekpieces enlisted and he remains unexposed on this introduction to fences.

runners_data.name: Millies Mite
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with poor recent form string, headgear change indicates trainer searching for improvement

runners_data.name: Model Approach
runners_data.note: Hold-up type coming off recent win just 9 days ago, risk of quick turnaround affecting performance

races.paceDynamic: Ballywood is the only confirmed front-runner and will lead unchallenged from the start, creating a genuine pace for the prominent runners Daany and Millies Mite to track. The hold-up horses Gone In Sixty, Grain Trade, Saint Polo, Holy Legend and Model Approach will settle towards the rear, relying on a strong finish over this 2m2f trip. With only one pace-setter and no pressure on the leader, this sets up as a tactical affair that will favour the patient hold-up types who can produce their best work late in the piece. The lack of early pace pressure strongly benefits the hold-up runners who can conserve energy and strike when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ballywood sets modest fractions without pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the early leaders to sustain their advantage, allowing the patient types to close decisively in the final 3f. Gone In Sixty and Grain Trade benefit most from their patient tactics and superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners capitalise
scenarios.trigger: If Daany and Millies Mite press Ballywood enough to create genuine pace without overdoing it
scenarios.body: The moderate tempo becomes ideal for the prominent runners to strike from close range, with enough pace to blunt the hold-up horses' finishing kicks. Daany's recent run and Millies Mite's tactical speed give them the edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner steals it
scenarios.trigger: If Ballywood gets easy fractions and the field fails to close the gap in time
scenarios.body: The veteran leader capitalises on soft splits to maintain his advantage all the way to the line, with the hold-up horses left with too much to do. Ballywood's experience at getting first run proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If no one pressures Ballywood at all and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The crawling pace negates all tactical advantages and turns it into a pure speed battle over the final 2f. Model Approach's recent win and Saint Polo's class could shine in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Gone In Sixty showing any signs of ring-rustiness early after his 172-day absence could rule him out completely
Ballywood getting too easy a time in front through the early stages as this will make him very hard to peg back
Saint Polo's jumping rhythm early on as the sharp drop back in trip could leave him racing too keenly
Model Approach looking laboured at any stage given his quick 9-day turnaround from his recent victory
Daany's position tracking the early pace as his prominent style needs him handy but not overcommitted

races.name: Best Of British Events Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Red One
runners_data.comment: Represents a top stable and is closely related to two useful jumpers; shortlisted
runners_data.spotlight: Sixth foal; closely related to useful winners Guard Your Dreams (2m-2m4f hurdle/chase) and Carys' Commodity (2m3f-2m6f hurdle/chase); dam unraced half-sister to useful bumper/jumps winner The Jigsaw Man; with a top stable; must be considered.

runners_data.name: Norff N Sauff
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to fair hurdler/chaser Quick Sharpener; stable does pretty well in bumpers
runners_data.spotlight: 24,000euros 3yo; seventh foal; half-brother to fair hurdler/chaser Quick Sharpener and a point winner; dam unraced half-sister to hurdle/chase winner Off The Charts; stable does pretty well in bumpers.
